title: 받침 있는 글자 쓰기: 3층 블록
objective: By the end, you can split a syllable with 받침 into its parts and write it in the right shape.
summary: Learn where the final consonant (받침) goes in a Korean syllable block.

task.title: Build and read blocks
task.line: Look at the parts and the shape of each syllable, then choose, write, or read the answer.

letters.sound: Side vowel (ㅏ ㅓ ㅣ): consonant left, vowel right, 받침 underneath.
Flat vowel (ㅗ ㅜ ㅡ): three floors, consonant, vowel, then 받침.
letters.as: 곰 [곰] gom: close your lips at the end, like 'home'.

exercises: Choose the shape. A = consonant and vowel side by side, 받침 below. B = three floors stacked: ① 문 ② 잠 ③ 콩
Put the parts together and write one syllable: ① ㅂ + ㅏ + ㄹ ② ㅅ + ㅗ + ㄴ ③ ㄱ + ㅡ + ㅁ
Split the syllable into first consonant + vowel + 받침: ① 집 ② 돈 ③ 길
Read aloud, then write the romanization: ① 몸 ② 방 ③ 일
answers: ① B ② A ③ B
① 발 ② 손 ③ 금
① ㅈ + ㅣ + ㅂ ② ㄷ + ㅗ + ㄴ ③ ㄱ + ㅣ + ㄹ
① mom ② bang ③ il
